subject: Lock-rate request + performance credits for 2-year prepay — Blueforge
messages:
From: Caroline Ellis <caroline@blueforge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@blueforge.com, Dan Miller <dan.miller@blueforge.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: 2-year prepay — locked rate + performance credits?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Blueforge really liked the latency profile on the analytics workloads. We're evaluating a 24-month prepay to lock-in pricing for our forecasting pipeline. Two asks from procurement: 1) confirm a locked per-token unit price for 24 months (we need price certainty for our finance model), and 2) can you build in a performance-based credit if throughput or latency thresholds are exceeded (e.g., sustained high utilization that impacts delivery SLA)?

High level numbers to use for modeling: expected steady-state ingest ~18B tokens/month starting in Q1 after onboarding, ramping from ~6B in month 1 of production. We're open to an upfront payment schedule (annual or full 24-mo upfront). Procurement requested an initial SOW — attaching Blueforge_SOW_v2.pdf.

Timeline: procurement needs pricing by Aug 20 to include in their board package. Can you confirm what information you need from us?

Thanks,
Caroline
Caroline Ellis
Head of Platform, Blueforge
attachments: Blueforge_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Caroline Ellis <caroline@blueforge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: 2-year prepay — locked rate + performance credits?

Caroline — thanks, this is very helpful. Quick clarifying Qs so we can model options:
- Do you want the locked unit price to apply to all tokens (ingest + generated), or just generation?
- Preferred billing cadence (annual upfront vs full 24-mo upfront)?
- Is Blueforge asking for reserved dedicated capacity (Redwood Dedicated) or hosted API with committed spend?

I'll loop in Ben (pricing) and Karthik (capacity/ops) to model a 2-year locked-rate proposal and a performance-credit structure. We'll prepare an internal worksheet and send a formal proposal with the legal/DocuSign path.

Targets: I'll aim to get a draft pricing proposal to you by Aug 5 so you have time for procurement review.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-08-02T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Blueforge pricing request — need discount + credit recommendation

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Blueforge's ask (see original below). Key points: 24-month prepay, want locked unit price, asks for a performance-based credit. They expect ~18B tokens/month steady-state; ramp from ~6B. Procurement wants pricing by Aug 20.

Questions:
- Ben: what is our standard discount at a 24-mo prepay at the $1.2M+/yr scale? Any precedent for a locked per-token price for 24 months? Recommend pricing tiers for ramp.
- Karthik: if they need reserved capacity, can we commit a Dedicated pool for the first 12 months and then re-evaluate? What does the ops risk look like for a large external customer on hosted vs Dedicated?

I'm attaching our working worksheet (pricing_calc.xlsx). Can you both review and I will consolidate for an external proposal?

Thanks — Irene
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-02T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Blueforge pricing request — need discount + credit recommendation

Irene — reviewed the worksheet and did a quick model. High-level recommendation below (numbers are illustrative; will publish to the shared sheet):

Base assumptions:
- Current list unit price we're using for modeling: $0.029 / token (generation + ingest blended).
- Proposed commitment: $1.2M / year (24-month = $2.4M total) — aligns with the volumes you gave.

Pricing proposal (recommended):
- Locked unit price: $0.024 / token (≈17% discount off list) for the full 24 months, applied to all billable tokens.
- Ramp bands: Months 1–3: apply a 25% ramp protection (bill at committed rate up to 50% of committed tokens), months 4–12 linear to steady state. We'll include true-up at each 6-month milestone.
- Performance credit (customer-friendly, simple): if monthly 95th-percentile latency for production pipelines is worse than target (we'd define SLA in SOW), provide a credit of 0.5% of monthly committed spend per breach, capped at 1.5% per month. Credit currency: applied as invoice credit.

Governance and approval notes:
- Above 15% discount is an exception requiring Sales Ops / Revenue approval. 17% is slightly over threshold; recommend we route for approval and document business rationale (strategic analytics customer, likely expansion).
- Need legal to confirm auto-trueup language and the definition of SLA breach.

I'll push a model into pricing_model_blueforge.xlsx and leave comments on cap/trueup triggers.

— Ben
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, SalesOps <salesops@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Approval request: 17–18% discount band for Blueforge (DF-8231) — business case enclosed

Hi Marissa / SalesOps,

Requesting approval for an exception to standard discount policy for Blueforge (deal DF-8231). Summary:
- Customer: Blueforge Analytics — strategic analytics platform, strong reference potential in adtech/finance verticals.
- Proposed commercial: 24-month prepay, total $2.4M (committed $1.2M/yr). Locked unit price: $0.024/token (proposed by Ben, ~17% off list).
- Additional ask: performance-credit structure as proposed (0.5% per breach, cap 1.5%/mo).

Business rationale: 1) large committed spend with potential to expand into Dedicated capacity, 2) reference value in a high-visibility vertical, 3) faster time-to-revenue via prepaid model. Procurement timeline: needs signed terms by Aug 20.

Requested approvals / next steps:
1) SalesOps approval for exception to discount policy (Ben's model shows ~17–18%).
2) Legal to draft amendment for locked price + SLA credit + trueup mechanics.
3) Finance to confirm billing cadence & revenue recognition implications for 24-mo prepay.

Attachments: pricing_model_blueforge.xlsx, pricing_calc.xlsx, Blueforge_SOW_v2.pdf

Thanks — Irene
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, SalesOps <salesops@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Approval request: 17–18% discount band for Blueforge (DF-8231) — business case enclosed

Irene / team — reviewed. Approve with the following conditions:
- Approve a locked rate equivalent to a 17% discount off list (set locked price at $0.0241/token to remain within approval band).
- Approve performance credit concept, cap the monthly credit at 1.5% of committed spend, and limit to documented SLA breaches only.
- Require an auto-trueup clause: if realized usage falls below 60% of committed ARR for any rolling 3-month window, include a trueup to the committed billing.
- Finance to confirm revenue recognition path; Legal to produce amendment and include a renewal trigger (90-day notice before term end) that preserves locked pricing for a follow-on commitment.

Marissa — Sales Strategy (on behalf of SalesOps)

Caroline / procurement team — attaching our formal proposal (redwood_proposal_blueforge.pdf) and the pricing worksheet. Key terms below:

- Approval: SalesOps has approved 17% band with conditions (see attached). Legal will prepare an amendment; if acceptable we will push DocuSign link for signature.

DocuSign link (proposal to sign): https://www.docusign.com/blueforge/DF-8231-proposal

Best,
